(2) The 'military' entry in script_coverage has no basis in the populated verify schema (which lists address_homeowner_confirmed, title_co_owners, residence_length, interest_in_solar, utility_company, average_bill, roof_type_age, prior_designs) — remove or justify this section against actual schema content. (3) Surface the speaker-diarization quality issue: multiple lines tagged 'rep' (00:04 'Yeah.', 00:14 'Great.', 01:10 'Yes.', 01:24 'Uh-huh. Backer battery?') read as customer responses misattributed to the rep. Given Stage 3 builds rep_intent and interest_reason_audit conclusions on turn-by-turn attribution, this should be flagged as a transcript-confidence caveat rather than treated as fully clean data. The orphaned_flow probe-miss coaching_implication (competitive intel data point) should also be softened or removed since it isn't grounded in any schema section — it's invented content presented as schema-adjacent. Outcome dispute (reclassification to 'dq') is well-supported and should be kept as-is.
